powo_wcvp.Herniaria fruticosa: accepted species; POWO also accepts H. fruticosa subsp. fruticosa
powo_wcvp.note: No evidence was found for any of the three V8 variety autonyms as the operative accepted treatment.

wfo.note: WFO evidence does not support the three V8 variety autonyms as accepted exact identities.

decisions.reason: Rioja flora and the Spanish national pattern list support the species rank; the active universe already contains that exact supported species. POWO's separate acceptance of subsp. fruticosa is retained as international taxonomic context but does not prove the Rioja population should be represented at that subspecific rank.
Rioja flora, Spanish national pattern list, POWO/WCVP, WFO and ANTHOS support H. glabra at species rank; the exact variety autonym is unsupported in the current evidence stack.

The complete Rioja flora block explicitly prints H. scabrida subsp. scabrida and the Spanish national pattern list contains the same exact subspecies. The existing species H. scabrida remains active as a separate higher-rank taxon record. POWO currently treats H. scabrida at species rank; this framework difference is preserved rather than silently collapsed.

guards: Do not infer Rioja occurrence of H. fruticosa subsp. fruticosa from international acceptance alone.
Do not preserve unsupported variety autonyms as active identities merely because their base species is valid.
Preserve all three original V8 strings and provenance in audit history.
Do not collapse the Spanish/local H. scabrida subsp. scabrida treatment into the international species-rank treatment.
No threat, protection or ex-situ score is inherited across the 1173 rank replacement without fresh downstream execution.
Apply exclusions/replacement only through a regenerated hash-safe active-universe overlay.
